rationale: The assistant landed on the right broad direction (start relay/overload, with the compressor as the alternative) and kept all hands-on work unplugged, but it never explored condenser cleanliness or ventilation and ignored the significance of the customer's 'very hot to touch' compressor, which bears directly on relay-vs-compressor. When the customer explicitly asked to 'buy the right part for my model', it gave generic swap instructions with hedged wire colours ('usually red, white, and yellow/black') and no help identifying the Bosch-specific part, nor any suggestion of an engineer to confirm before purchase. A service outage also cost a turn, and the resend added nothing new. Useful but unfinished and under-specified for a real homeowner.
